say:2:1341123001:1.text: Chippy, why are you staring at my weapon like that?
say:2:1341123001:1.source_cn: 满满，你为什么用这么奇怪的眼神看着我的武器？

say:3:1341123002:1.text: That is one exquisite broadsword! And your armor is nicely designed and practical... You have the best knight gear!
say:3:1341123002:1.source_cn: 你的骑士大剑可真漂亮！还有你的板甲……又精美又实用，是...

say:4:1341123003:1.text: Well, they are my most trusted companions and the symbols of my dignity and honor.
say:4:1341123003:1.source_cn: 那当然，它们是一位骑士最能信赖的伙伴，也是骑士的尊严和...

say:5:1341123004:1.text: Chippy gets you! I'll never part with my sword and armor, not even if I fall into the sea!
say:5:1341123004:1.source_cn: 对呀对呀！无论如何，满满都不会抛弃剑和胸甲，就算是掉进...

say:6:1341123005:1.text: Chippy held onto them even during the shipwreck in the Stormy Strait!
say:6:1341123005:1.source_cn: 上次在斯托密海峡遭遇海难的时候，满满就是穿着它们沉到海里的！

say:7:1341123006:1.text: Um, that's a bit too much... Safety comes first, alright?
say:7:1341123006:1.source_cn: 咳，其实……也不必这么坚持……生命第一位，对吧？
